elements.requirement: A person is guilty of an offence if that person pursues a course of conduct in breach of section 1(1) or (1A).
elements.quote: A person who pursues a course of conduct in breach of section 1(1) or (1A) is guilty of an offence

elements.requirement: A person guilty of an offence under section 2 is liable on summary conviction to imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months, or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale, or both.
elements.quote: liable on summary conviction to imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months, or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale, or both

thresholds.what: maximum term of imprisonment on summary conviction
thresholds.quote: imprisonment for a term not exceeding six months

thresholds.what: maximum fine level on the standard scale
thresholds.quote: fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale
